posts.headline: One Nut Barner has now gone twenty-six straight editions without saying a single word, and Put it in Ra's 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and zero rings is starting to look like the loudest silence in league history.
posts.detail: A .714 win pct and back-to-back top-2 finishes and still nothing but crickets — this column is officially begging for a rebuttal on draft night.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World finally sits at the draft table tonight, and Big Head has zero editions left to explain a title sitting on top of a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Seven straight editions of silence on that fluke jury, and now the actual draft picks start writing the next chapter whether Megamind talks or not.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT drafts for real tonight, and the Ultimate Light Skin is one bad pick away from re-enacting the DEFENSIVE-player-first-overall sermon this league still isn't over.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record and a 5.5 average finish is not the resume of a prophet — Eli owes this league scripture, not another plague.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafts tonight still owning the worst résumé in the league, a 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish that made the untalented tenth nickname write itself.
posts.detail: Fresh players don't erase a 0.286 win pct — this is the one draft that actually matters for shaking the reputation.

posts.headline: Thicks and the #FreeMaxx Champions finally get to back up the ring tonight, and a 5.5 average finish across two seasons says the pressure is all on the draft board now.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record is a .500 team wearing a champion's crown — tonight's picks decide if that crown was earned or borrowed.
